app.subtitle: interactive fire simulation
manual.link.title: Opens the user manual in a new tab
area.pickCenter.title: Click on the map to set the center of the simulation area
area.pickIgnition.title: Click on the map to set the fire ignition point (must be on vegetated land, not on a town or city)
area.radius.title: Radius of the area around the chosen center, in km (max 50)
area.cellsize.title: Size of the simulation grid cell, in meters: lower values give more detail but take longer to compute
weather.windDir.title: Direction the wind is blowing from, in degrees from north (0°=North, 90°=East, 180°=South, 270°=West)
weather.windSpeed.title: Wind speed, in km/h
weather.moisture.title: Fuel moisture, as a percentage: higher values slow down fire spread
sim.duration.title: Simulated duration of the fire, in hours
sim.resolution.title: How often a results frame (map, statistics) is saved
sim.realizations.title: Number of independent stochastic simulations run: higher values give more reliable probability estimates but take longer
sim.spotting.title: If enabled, the model generates wind-carried embers that can start new spot fires ahead of the main front
sim.isochrone.title: Probability thresholds (0-1, comma-separated) for which isochrones are drawn on the map
sim.includePois.title: Fetch OpenStreetMap points of interest (hospitals, schools, fire/police stations, power infrastructure, major roads, buildings) in the area and report fire arrival at each
sim.maxPois.title: Maximum number of POIs to fetch/report for the area (higher-priority categories and those closest to the center are kept first)
sim.poiCategories.title: Which POI categories to fetch/report
poi.legend.title: Points of interest: color shows whether the fire front has reached them yet
actions.type.title: Type of intervention (the added moisture stacks on top of the base value and decays over time, about -1%/minute): Canadair +25% on the line, +22% in the one-cell buffer; Waterline +27% on the line and buffer; Helicopter +22% on scattered points along the line, +20% in the buffer; Heavy vehicles: does not affect moisture, replaces the fuel with a non-flammable strip
actions.canadair.title: Moisture +25% on the line, +22% in the one-cell buffer (stacks on top of the base value, then decays over time)
actions.helicopter.title: Moisture +22% on scattered points along the line, +20% in the one-cell buffer (stacks on top of the base value, then decays over time)
actions.waterline.title: Moisture +27% along the whole line and the one-cell buffer (stacks on top of the base value, then decays over time)
actions.heavy.title: Does not affect moisture: permanently replaces the fuel along the line (and one-cell buffer) with a non-flammable strip
actions.actionTime.title: Hours from the start of the simulation at which the action is carried out
actions.drawLine.title: Click on the map to add points to the intervention line, then press Finish line
actions.finishLine.title: Finishes the drawn line and adds the action to the list
actions.remove.title: Removes this action from the simulation
run.button.title: Start the simulation with the current settings
result.frameSlider.title: Scrub to see the fire map hour by hour, across the available results
result.statAreaMean.title: Expected burned area: sum of each cell's fire probability × cell area (hectares)
result.statArea50.title: Area where the fire arrived in at least 50% of the simulated realizations (hectares)
result.statNActive.title: Number of realizations, out of the total configured, whose fire front is still active at this instant
result.statFrameCount.title: Number of time instants (hourly frames) available for this simulation
result.chart.title: Burned area over time: solid line = expected mean area, dashed line = area with probability ≥50%
